## Goal
A page a worried person, or their helper, can read in two minutes: what Free My ID never asks for, how a real Free My ID message looks, and what to do if someone asks in its name.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Uses the app's own promise, word for word where possible: "No account. No cloud. Never asks for your Social Security number, bank or card details." (`src/freemyid/wizard/ui.py:266-267`), "It never pays." and "It will never ask for a Social Security number or bank or card details." (`src/freemyid/wizard/dashboard.py:529`), and `src/freemyid/wizard/views.py:273`.
- Names the same three core items as the website's Is it safe? page (`web/src/pages/safety/index.astro`, read-only; `tests/copilot/test_cp_never_asks_parity.py` treats it as the master list). Any difference goes in VENDOR_STATUS.md as a finding.
- Explains, honestly, what the person may be asked by a people-search site or a credit bureau on their own site (for example a photo ID or an account, `dashboard.py:129`), and that Free My ID stops and asks first.
- "If someone calls, texts or emails as Free My ID and asks for money, a password, a code or your Social Security number: it is not us. Hang up or don't reply. Tell someone you trust." Calm, no alarm words, no fear selling (`docs/POSITIONING.md` rule 3).
- No phone number, email address or web address for "reporting" unless it is already in the repo with a source.
- Expected: `tests/copilot/test_cp_user_docs_reachable.py` fails exactly one case, `test_user_page_is_reachable[never-asks.md]`, because nothing links the new page yet. That is by design: WO-330 links it, and in-house merges this WO and WO-330 together before pushing. Record that one failure in VENDOR_STATUS.md; any other failure is yours to fix.

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** text only and offline. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Plain words per `docs/POSITIONING.md`: no "guarantee", "erase", "100%" or "nothing is sent"; say "requested" and "confirmed". A real product bug is a file:line finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md (or a strict `xfail` in a test); never edit `src/`. Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/` and `tests/grok/` first; don't duplicate a guard.

Page rules (new help pages, WO-311..320):
- Quote screen text and button labels exactly as the app shows them, with the source as `src/freemyid/<path>.py:NNN` in an HTML comment on the same line. `tests/copilot/test_cp_source_citations.py` checks that the line exists and that quoted text on that line is in that file. Cite anything that isn't under `src/freemyid/` in words ("brokers/checklists.yaml, line 22"; "packaging/windows/splash_win.py, line 20"), because only `src/freemyid/` files resolve.
- Link only to pages that exist on main today. Don't link to other new pages in this batch: WO-330 adds the help-topics page that links them all.
- First line under the title: who the page is for and what it helps with, in one sentence. Then short sentences (about 15 words), one step per line, numbered steps. No screenshots (none can be made offline). No web addresses except ones the app itself shows; never a GitHub link for regular users.
